metadata.task: Retrieve the bread, butter, and jam from the refrigerator and pantry, place them on the dining table, and return the unused items to their original locations.

plan.goal: Retrieve bread, butter, and jam from storage (refrigerator/pantry), place them on the dining table, and return unused items to their original locations.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the refrigerator and locate the bread inside.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Kitchen Entrance. Bread is stored in the Refrigerator.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Refrigerator. Bread is located and identified.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must navigate to the Refrigerator room to access the bread.
Robot must detect the bread object within the refrigerator scene.
Robot must recognize the detected object as 'Bread'.
Robot must estimate the 3D pose of the bread to enable grasping.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Retrieve the bread from the refrigerator and place it on the dining table.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Refrigerator. Bread is located and its pose is estimated.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Dining Table. Bread is placed on the table.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must grasp the bread from the refrigerator.
Robot must navigate to the Dining Table to place the bread.
Robot must place the bread on the dining table.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the pantry and locate the butter and jam inside.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Dining Table. Bread is placed on the table.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Pantry. Butter and Jam are located and identified.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must navigate to the Pantry room to access butter and jam.
Robot must detect the butter object within the pantry scene.
Robot must recognize the detected object as 'Butter'.
Robot must estimate the 3D pose of the butter to enable grasping.
Robot must detect the jam object within the pantry scene.
Robot must recognize the detected object as 'Jam'.
Robot must estimate the 3D pose of the jam to enable grasping.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Retrieve the butter and jam from the pantry and place them on the dining table.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Pantry. Butter and Jam are located and their poses are estimated.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Dining Table. Bread, Butter, and Jam are all placed on the table.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must grasp the butter from the pantry.
Robot must grasp the jam from the pantry.
Robot must navigate to the Dining Table to place the items.
Robot must place the butter on the dining table.
Robot must place the jam on the dining table.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Return the unused items (butter and jam) to their original locations.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Dining Table. Bread, Butter, and Jam are all placed on the table.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Pantry. Bread is on the table; Butter and Jam are returned to the pantry.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must pick up the butter from the dining table.
Robot must navigate to the pantry to return the butter.
Robot must place the butter back in the pantry.
Robot must pick up the jam from the dining table.
Robot must navigate to the pantry to return the jam.
Robot must place the jam back in the pantry.
